Class CoMoMSolver

java.lang.Object
solvers.queueingnet.QNSolver
solvers.queueingnet.CoMoMSolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
QNSolverInterface
Direct Known Subclasses:
CoMoMBTFSolver, CoMoMSimpleSolver
public class CoMoMSolver extends QNSolver
This class provides the high-level implementation of the CoMoM algorithm, it is programmed to the interface provided by the LinearSystem class. Sub-classes must choose the linear system they are to use.
Author:
Jack Bradshaw *
